voice.name: Roger - Laid-Back, Casual, Resonant
voice.why: The sawmill foreman is easy-going and dry, a man who talks over the noise of a saw without raising his voice. Roger is a laid-back middle-aged American with a resonant but lighter tone than Bruno's baritone.

greet.text: Lucien Maury. I keep the saws running at the Everon mill. Bring logs, and I will keep you busy.

next_top.text: I have nothing left to show you. You know every saw in this yard.

next_02.text: Next up, level 2. Felling permit: fell trees with an axe. Keep the blade sharp.

next_03.text: Next up, level 3. Sawmill hand license: saw logs into planks. Keep the blade sharp.

next_04.text: Next up, level 4. Seasoned logger license: fell trees twice as fast. Keep the blade sharp.

next_10.text: Next up, level 10. First perk: pick Double yield or Swift hands at the labor office. Keep the blade sharp.

next_20.text: Next up, level 20. Second perk: Light touch and Good word join the choices at the labor office. Keep the blade sharp.
